2609.35744.title: FinAutoRubric: Expert-Guided Automatic Rubric Generation for Evaluating Financial Research Agents
2609.35744.paper_summary: Evaluating finance research agents requires rubrics that reflect expert standards and fix the values correct as of an information cutoff. Expert-reviewed finance benchmarks rely on fixed, per-item rubrics, which are costly to extend and cannot encode each institution's own standard. In FinAutoRubric, experts specify reusable evaluation guidance, while agents and code carry out query-specific rubric generation, review, and validation. This expert guidance governs every agent, as prompts and as rules that code enforces, and a Task Bank of reusable criteria carries it across tasks. In long-horizon loops that follow the expert guidance, a writer agent researches every expected value and a reviewer agent verifies it, and failures escalate to a human. On three expert-authored finance benchmarks, its rubrics track expert scoring as closely as the strongest evaluated generator while stating the expert rubric's expected value for more criteria, their scores agree with human grading, and in-house analysts prefer them in a blind review. The released 100-query FinAutoRubric Benchmark, built from in-house analysts' key questions across 78 tasks and eight asset classes, shows that rubrics from an earlier model generation still leave headroom for a later one.
2609.35744.paper_summary_zh: 評估金融研究代理需要反映專家標準的評分標準，並在資訊截止時修正正確的值。經專家審核的金融基準依賴固定的逐項評分標準，這些標準擴展成本高昂，且無法編碼每個機構自己的標準。在FinAutoRubric中，專家指定可重用的評估指導，而代理和程式執行查詢特定的評分標準生成、審查和驗證。這些專家指導規範每個代理，作為提示和程式強制執行的規則，並且可重用標準的任務庫將其帶入各項任務。在遵循專家指導的長期循環中，寫作代理研究每個預期值，而審查代理則驗證該值，失敗情況會升級到人類。在三個專家撰寫的金融基準中，其評分標準與最強的評估生成器的專家評分緊密對應，同時陳述專家評分標準對更多標準的預期值，他們的分數與人類評分一致，並且內部分析師在盲評中更偏好它們。釋出的100查詢FinAutoRubric基準是基於內部分析師在78個任務和八個資產類別中的關鍵問題構建的，顯示早期模型生成的評分標準仍然留有後續模型的提升空間。
